name: 27601 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27601 (Raleigh) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27601 (Raleigh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27601 (Raleigh) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
